case: Exact datetimeoffset text parsing and native keyed grid edits
contract: SQL Server catalog metadata includes the declared datetimeoffset scale so the app can reject fractional input that would be rounded by the destination column.

The mssql app parser validates the SQL Server datetimeoffset syntax, scale 0 through 7, the plus/minus 14-hour offset bound, and local and UTC years 1 through 9999; valid input stays Value::Text to preserve its local time and original offset.

The app grid test edits three primary-keyed rows across positive, negative and -14:00 offsets, including year 0001; SQL Server verifies local text, offset minutes and all 11 native bytes, while a year-9999 sibling remains unchanged.
A parser unit contract accepts valid scale 0 and scale 3 inputs and refuses excess fractional precision, +14:01, local/UTC year overflow, malformed separators and a missing offset.
